name: Medication Schedule

map.多病共病老人常需多种药物，用计划表梳理药名、剂量、频次与首次服药时间。: Older adults with multiple conditions often need many medicines; use a plan sheet to organise the name, dose, frequency and first dose time.
map.复杂方案建议与医生/药师核对，尤其抗凝、降糖、降压类。: Complex plans should be checked with a doctor or pharmacist, especially anticoagulants, hypoglycaemic drugs and antihypertensives.
map.逐项添加『药名-剂量-间隔(小时)-首次时间』，如『降压药 1片 间隔24 首次: Add 'name - dose - interval (hours) - first time' item by item, e.g. 'antihypertensive 1 tablet, interval 24, first 08:00'; the tool computes the following dose times from the interval and generates a daily table.
map.多药同服要注意什么？: What to watch for when taking several medicines together?
map.重点查相互作用与给药时机（空腹/餐后）、重复成分（如多种感冒药含同种成分）、以及: Focus on interactions and dosing timing (fasting / after meals), duplicated ingredients (for example several cold remedies containing the same ingredient), and the effect of liver and kidney function on the dose. Any change to the plan must go through a doctor or pharmacist.
map.漏服了怎么办？: What if a dose is missed?
map.切勿自行加倍补服。多数情况按『想起即补、若近下次给药则跳过』原则，具体遵药品说明: Never double up on your own. In most cases follow the principle of 'take it as soon as you remember, and skip it if it is close to the next dose'; follow the package insert or consult the pharmacist to avoid overdosing.
map.📖 查看「用药日程表 使用指南」: View the Medication Schedule User Guide
map.输入用药方案后生成时间表；不主动提醒、不检查相互作用或餐食要求（本地生成，不上传: Builds a timetable from your plan; no active reminders and no interaction or food checks (local only, not uploaded).
map.仅生成时间表，不会主动提醒，也不检查药物相互作用或餐食要求。: Generates a timetable only. It sends no active alerts and does not check interactions or food requirements.
map.以下药物未排程，请先修正：: These medicines were not scheduled; fix them first:
map.当前没有可排程的用药时间点。: No schedulable dose times at present.
map.请选择开始日期；清空后不会自动用今天替代。: Select a start date; an empty field will not be silently replaced with today.
map.观察天数须为 1–30 的整数；留空或越界不会自动按 1 天计算。: Days must be an integer from 1 to 30; blank or out-of-range values are not silently treated as 1 day.
map.首剂时间须为 HH:MM: First dose time must be HH:MM
map.仅生成用药时间表，不会主动发出通知或闹钟，也不检查药物相互作用、空腹/餐后要求或: This tool only builds a timetable; it does not send notifications or alarms, and does not check interactions, food requirements, or dose suitability. Set your own reminders and have a clinician or pharmacist review the plan. All input stays in this browser and is never uploaded.
map.工具只把给药点叠加到时间轴，便于人工核对是否撞在同一时刻；它不检查药物相互作用、: The tool only places dose times on a timeline so you can check for clashes manually; it does not check interactions or food requirements and sends no active reminders. Confirm the plan with a clinician or pharmacist.
map.按 24 小时制排布给药点，便于人工核对漏服/重复；工具不检查药物相互作用。: Places dose times on a 24-hour timeline for manual review of missed or duplicate doses; it does not check interactions.
map.服药间隔按频次折算：每日 1 次为 24 小时、每日 2 次为 12 小时、每日: Interval conversion: once daily = 24 h, twice daily = 12 h, three times daily = 8 h, four times daily = 6 h. Dose time = first dose time + interval x n (n from 0); doses per day = 24 / interval. Medicines are merged and sorted into an all-day timetable.

desc: Build a medication timetable; no active reminders or interaction checks.
